title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff/hysteresis and regional failover (load-shedding edge-case)
author: Priya Patel
description: Fixes a regression in the SLO enforcer that caused aggressive backoff/hysteresis interactions to trigger cross-region circuit-breakers and excessive load-shedding during transient infra pressure. Root cause: a race between regional health updates and the hysteresis timer which could mark a region unhealthy prematurely and then double-apply backoff when failover logic re-evaluated the queue. This PR makes the regional health->circuit-breaker state transitions atomic, smooths backoff hysteresis thresholds, adds explicit queue accounting when applying load-shedding, and improves observability for safe rollouts. Changes are backward-compatible configuration defaults; includes unit and e2e sim tests and an emergency deploy checklist. References: ENG-4521, ENG-4602, SUP-9842.
commits: Fix atomic regional CB state transition and guard races
Smooth backoff hysteresis thresholds and add smoothing window config
Add explicit queue-accounting to load-shedding gate to avoid double-counting
Add e2e simulation tests for regional failover + load-shed scenarios
Add telemetry and logs for CB transitions and backoff decisions
Docs: rollout checklist and mitigations for on-call
